description: Labeled social-arb EXIT cases: trends past their velocity peak / confirm date, with the REALIZED forward return AFTER the saturation point. Edge is time-decaying information asymmetry (Camillo EXIT-on-parity); once Wall Street caught up (earnings/credit-card confirm passed, social velocity rolled over) the residual move is adverse to the stale stance. The PDR-4 decay shrinks the saturated semantic view so the silenced position AVOIDS the post-parity drawdown. External-truth labels (realized forward returns), never self-graded.

cases.note: Earnings (confirm_date) passed; Wall Street caught up; edge gone -> the silenced view AVOIDS the post-parity drawdown.
Energy-drink craze fully priced post-earnings; momentum reversed; stale bull stance bleeds.
Coach handbag trend confirmed by quarterly; info parity reached; modest adverse drift.
Elmer-glue slime fad past peak; consumer-staples mean-reversion; stale view drawdown.
FRESH case (decision only ~9 days after packet, no confirm): edge still live, decay near 1.0, return positive -> sat must NOT meaningfully shrink a still-fresh winner.
